name: Salted Caramel Iced Latte
flavor_notes: Silky cold milk and sweet salted caramel balanced by bold, toasted espresso with a buttery caramel finish.
barista_note: Pantry shortcut: 2.5 oz Chobani Caramel Macchiato or Sweet Cream creamer can replace both the milk and caramel syrup. Add a tiny pinch of flaky sea salt on top to cut through the sweetness.

review.verdict: The pinch of flaky sea salt is mandatory — it cuts through the rich caramel and highlights the chocolate undertones of the espresso.

channel_verdicts.cometeer: Medium roast extract brings out natural hazelnut and toasted sugar notes.
channel_verdicts.nespresso: Vertuo single Altissio or Chiaro provides ideal roast density.
channel_verdicts.instant: Instant coffee crystals dissolve cleanly into the caramel drizzle with 2 oz hot water.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced medium roast with caramel and toasted nut notes that complement salted caramel syrup.

ingredients.item: Cometeer capsule, fully melted and chilled

steps: Melt the Cometeer capsule completely and chill before pouring.
In a glass, combine the cold milk and salted caramel syrup; stir until blended.
Pour the chilled Cometeer extract over the ice to layer, then drizzle with caramel sauce.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced medium roast with toasted biscuit and caramel notes that complement salted caramel syrup.

ingredients.item: Nespresso Vertuo Double Espresso pod (Chiaro or Scuro)

steps: Add ice and salted caramel syrup to a tall glass.
Brew Double Espresso Chiaro (or two single shots) directly over the ice to rapidly chill.
Pour cold milk over the espresso and stir gently.
Finish with a drizzle of caramel sauce over the crema foam.

preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Medaglia d'Oro
preparations.roast_note: A smooth, balanced instant espresso that dissolves cleanly without harsh bitter edges.
steps: In a small cup, dissolve the instant coffee and salted caramel syrup into 2 oz of hot water.
Fill a serving glass with ice and add the cold milk.
Pour the hot caramel-espresso concentrate over the iced milk.
Drizzle caramel sauce over the top and stir.
